test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An amount of ₹8,000 is invested at 10% compound interest. What will be the amount after 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹8000

Rate (r) = 10%

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1+(r)/(100))^t 

**Calculations:**

A = 8000 (1+(10)/(100))³ 

⇒ A = 8000 (1.1)³ 

⇒ A = 8000 × 1.331

⇒ A = 10648

**∴ Amount after 3 years = ₹10,648**
